10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Three short technique clips from the 10th Planet 'Freak Bros' series, taught by Boogey. Each one starts with an arm drag (pulling the opponent's arm across their centreline so you can get to their side) and finishes differently: one takes the back, one goes into a darce choke when the opponent turns into you, and one uses a 'kickflip' to swing your legs around and take the back when they resist.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Anyone who wants quick, specific no-gi arm drag follow-ups. Each clip is only a few minutes.
key: Arm drag to darce when they turn in
Kickflip back take when the drag stalls

files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Arm Drag: The basic arm drag finished by climbing to the back with a seatbelt and hooks.
When the opponent turns back into you after the drag, threading the darce choke.
A rolling 'kickflip' variation to reach the back when the opponent squares up.

sources: Based on the chapter titles and 10th Planet's published Freak Bros technique series.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Two clips from PJ on turning an opponent's leg attack into your back take. Rather than just escaping the ashi garami, you use the opponent's commitment to the legs to spin behind them.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players who get caught in leg entanglements and want offensive escapes.
key: Forcing a DOA (double outside ashi) position into a back take
The turn-out escape linked to a berimbolo

files.PJ - Force DOA to Back Take.mp4: From the leg entanglement, forcing the double outside ashi and spinning to the back.
files.PJ - Turn-Out Escape to Berimbolo.mp4: Turning out of the leg attack and following with a berimbolo to the back.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: A single short clip from Boogey on attacking once you have the back in no-gi: keeping control, fighting the hands and getting to the choke.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: A quick refresher on back attack details.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez shows the 'butter-half' guard: half guard with a butterfly hook inside, used to elevate the opponent and create angles. The four clips cover the main attacks from it, including getting to ashi garami, the guillotine, the kimura, and the choice between the truck and the back.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Half guard players who want more offence from the bottom, especially in no-gi.
key: Elevating with the butterfly hook from half guard

files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - Butter-Half: Using the butterfly hook to elevate and enter ashi garami.
Guillotine attack when the top player's head drops.
Kimura grip and finish from butter-half.
Coming out the back door to the truck, or taking the back.

sources: Based on the chapter titles and Geo Martinez's published material.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on escapes. Two clips cover escaping bottom north-south, and the third shows the 'Super Jailbreak', a 10th Planet escape from a bad bottom position (a dangerous half guard or side control) that gets you back to safety or offence.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Anyone who gets stuck under north-south or heavy top pressure.

files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - North-South: First north-south escape: framing, creating space and turning in.
Second north-south escape option when the first is blocked.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on countering ashi garami: escaping to reverse knee on belly, then attacking from there with the omoplata or the ultra kimura. The folder also has three MMA conditioning videos (a short tutorial and two full follow-along workouts) that aren't jiu-jitsu technique.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players who want to punish leg attacks, and anyone wanting the bonus workouts.
key: Escape to reverse knee on belly
Bonus MMA strength and conditioning workouts

files.Geo - Ashi Escape to Reverse Knee on Bel: Escaping the leg attack into reverse knee on belly.
files.Geo - Ashi Escape to RVRS KOB to Omoplat: From reverse knee on belly into the omoplata.
files.Geo - Ashi Escape to RVRS KOB to Ultra K: From reverse knee on belly into the ultra kimura.
files.MMA Power Learn It & Work It.mkv: Workout tutorial: learning the movements before the power workout (not BJJ technique).
files.MMA Power Workout.mkv: A follow-along MMA power workout (about 47 minutes).

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Boogey shows a double-under pass that finishes with the violin armbar (an armbar from the double-under / stacking position), plus a follow-up from the violin armbar to the back when the opponent defends.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Passers who like stacking and want a submission off the pass.
key: Back take when the armbar is defended

files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Double U: From double unders into the violin armbar.
files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Violin A: When the armbar is blocked, transitioning to the back.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on escaping the two starting positions of EBI overtime rules: the spider web armbar and back control. Under EBI rules the faster escape wins, so the focus is on escaping quickly and efficiently.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Competitors in EBI or submission-only rule sets, and anyone wanting a fast armbar and back escape.

files.Geo - EBI OT Armbar Escape.mp4: Escaping the spider web armbar start.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: A set of 10th Planet standing guard passes, the 'M series' (M1, M2), plus a far-side shin slide and a long step variation. These are standing passes against open guard that change the angle quickly.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi passers who stand up against open guard.

files.Farside Shin Slide.mp4: Sliding the shin across on the far side to pass.
files.M1 Long Step.mp4: The M1 pass finished with a long step.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Three no-gi escapes from bottom mount from Boogey: 'Escape from Alcatraz', a 'Hail Mary' that goes to ashi garami, and the upa (trap-and-roll) bridge, with bloopers included.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Anyone wanting a few extra mount escape options beyond the basics.

files.Boogey - Hail Mary to Ashi.mp4: A last-ditch escape that ends in ashi garami.
files.Boogey - Upa ft. Bloopers.mp4: The upa bridge and roll (with outtakes).

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: A single short movement drill from Geo Martinez: the one-hand jump back, a solo movement used in 10th Planet warm-ups.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Warm-up and movement practice.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on no-gi reverse De La Riva: the key details of the position, then the 'side chick' sweep, a single leg finish, the spiral guard variation and 'the remix', which combines the options.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Open guard players who want a no-gi RDLR game.

files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - Reverse De: Grips, hook placement and posture for RDLR.
Coming up into a single leg from RDLR.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Boogey shows four short rubber guard pieces: breaking the posture to get there, the gogoplata, the meat hook triangle and 'the carni'.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Flexible closed guard players exploring the rubber guard.

files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Rubber G: Breaking the opponent's posture to establish rubber guard.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Boogey shows the shin-to-shin guard sweep against a standing opponent and three ways to finish it: into an armbar, into knee on belly, and into an omoplata.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Seated guard players who want to off-balance standing passers.
key: Armbar and omoplata off the sweep

files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Shin Swe: Shin sweep straight into an armbar.
Shin sweep finishing on top in knee on belly.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Ricky Lule shows snapping a standing opponent down to the mat and rolling into the anaconda choke from the front headlock.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players looking for a standing-to-submission sequence.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Boogey on the spider web (the armbar control position where you're perpendicular to the opponent holding their arm): the key control details, the bicep slicer when they hold their hands together, and a reverse grip break to free the arm for the armbar.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Anyone who gets to the armbar but can't break the grip.
key: Reverse grip break into the armbar

files.Boogey - Spiderweb Details.mp4: Control details in the spider web.
files.Boogey - Spiderweb to Reverse Grip Break: Breaking the grip with a reverse grip.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Four standing submission attacks: the darcotine (a darce/guillotine hybrid), the high elbow guillotine, the pretzel grip guillotine, and using the vice grip to set up the darce.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players who want to submit from the clinch or a front headlock while standing.

files.Standing Attacks - High Elbow Guillotine: The high elbow guillotine from standing.
files.Standing Attacks - Vice Grip to Darce.mp: Using the vice grip to set up the darce.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Two quick clips on the swim move, which pummels an arm through to get around or behind the opponent, shown from guard and from the back.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: A quick look at a useful transition move.

files.Swim Move from Guard.mp4: Using the swim move from guard.
files.Swim Move from the Back.mp4: Using the swim move when on the back.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on the truck, the signature 10th Planet position behind and to the side of a turtled opponent with their leg trapped. Covers moving between the back and the truck, the banana split and baby twister, riding the roll into the calf slicer, the samurai roll into the 'truck stop', and the pre-hook entry.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players who want to attack the turtle and the back with the truck system.
key: Back to truck and truck to back

files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - The Truck -: Moving between back control and the truck.
Banana split and baby twister finishes.
Following the roll into the calf slicer.
The samurai roll into the truck stop.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Geo Martinez on the ultra kimura, a 10th Planet kimura variation with extra leverage. Four entries: as a counter to double unders, from a rolling kimura, from a top-side kimura, and from the turtle.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: Kimura fans who want more finishing options.

files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - Double Unde: Countering the double-under pass with the ultra kimura.
files.Freak Bros Technique - Geo - Turtle to U: Attacking the turtle with the ultra kimura.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.overview: Boogey on the vice grip, a front headlock and head-and-arm grip used to set up chokes. Covers the set-ups, then the darce, the Japanese necktie and the Peruvian necktie.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Freak.for: No-gi players who like the front headlock.

files.Freak Bros Technique - Boogey - Vice Gri: Vice grip to the Japanese necktie.
Vice grip to the Peruvian necktie.
How to get the vice grip.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Five episodes of a 10th Planet Rochester video blog ('TWIR'), each covering one topic: 50/50 counters, scissor sweep attacks and counters, the electric cowboy (a lockdown half guard position) and its escapes, judo-style side control attacks, and the cobra series.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: 10th Planet students and anyone wanting a mix of half guard, closed guard and top attacks.

files.10th Planet Jiu Jitsu Rochester_ TWIR Vi: The scissor sweep, its attacks and counters.
The electric cowboy and escaping it.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: A four-part recording of Eddie Bravo's November 2009 seminar in Vancouver. The files aren't labelled by topic. Seminars from this period typically cover his core system (the lockdown half guard and rubber guard) with technique and Q&A.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: 10th Planet fans who want to see Eddie teach his system live.
key: Eddie Bravo's core system as taught in 2009
sources: Based on the file names; topics within each part are not labelled.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Eleven short takedown clips for no-gi: capturing the legs, four ways to finish the double leg (outside hook, lift and split, drive across, pop and dump), and the single leg (chest pressure, lifting to sweep from inside and outside, the knee tap, the lift).
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: Grapplers who want a simple wrestling base for no-gi.
key: Double leg entry and four finishes

Shooting and capturing the legs for the double.
files.02 Double Leg Finish - Outside Hook.ID2k: Finishing with an outside leg hook.
files.07 Lift to Sweep Single Inside.ID2K.avi: Lift and inside sweep on the single.
files.08 Capturing the Leg - General Theory.ID: General theory of capturing the leg.
files.09 Lift to Sweep Single Leg.ID2K.avi: Lift and sweep on the single.
files.11 Single Leg Lift.ID2K.avi: Lifting the single leg to finish.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Short clips on the dog fight, the position where the bottom player comes up on an elbow with an underhook from half guard. Covers the limp arm, options from the dog fight, and 'the mooky'.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: Half guard players who come up on the underhook.

files.Limp_Arm.flv: The limp arm to free your arm.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Fifteen clips on Eddie Bravo's half guard system: taking the back ('100 percent to back'), the boa and its follow-ups to the truck or back, getting to the twister, quarter guard attacks (calf crank, samurai to the back), the electric pendulum into the dog fight, and the top player's side: breaking the lockdown and passing with the twister side pass or the capoeira pass.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: Lockdown/half guard players, and top players who face the lockdown.
key: Ways to get to the twister and truck

files.100 percent to back.flv: A high-percentage route to the back from half guard.
files.BoaToLimpArmToTwisterSide.flv: From the boa, limp arm to twister side control.
files.breaking the lockdown twsiter side pass: Breaking the lockdown, twister side pass part 1.
files.breaking the lockdown capeoria pass.flv: The capoeira pass against the lockdown.
files.ElectricPendulumToDogfight.flv: The electric pendulum into the dog fight.
files.GettingToTruckFromLockdown.flv: From the lockdown to the truck.
files.quarter_guard_to_back_samurai.flv: Quarter guard to the back with the samurai roll.
files.TheBoaToTheTruckOrBack.flv: From the boa to the truck or the back.
files.twsiter side pass theory.flv: Theory of the twister side pass.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Two short clips: an armbar option from mount, and a calf crank from quarter guard. The second appears to be the same clip as in the Half Guard folder.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: A quick look at the topics named.

files.CalfCrankFromQuarterGuard.flv: Calf crank from quarter guard (also in the Half Guard folder).

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: Eleven clips on Eddie Bravo's rubber guard: Eddie talking through the options, rubber guard control, mad dog control, the double bagger and submissions from it, the crowbar, the sorcerer and the flying kung fu.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: Rubber guard players and 10th Planet students.
key: Crowbar, sorcerer and flying kung fu

Eddie talks through the options, part 1.
files.rubber_guard_basic_path.flv: The basic rubber guard path (very short).
files.RubberGuardControl.flv: Controlling the opponent in rubber guard.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.overview: A single clip on ways to get to the spider web (armbar control) position.

Twister side control, the 10th Planet top position facing the legs that leads to the twister. Covers the 'Swedish twister', going from twister side to mount, and twister side to the mountain arm triangle.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Pack/.for: Top players in the 10th Planet system.

files.TwisterSideToMountainArmTriangle.flv: Twister side control to the mountain arm triangle.

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Short.overview: Six short videos from the 10th Planet 'Fade to Black' choke series, each on one choke: the darce, Peruvian necktie, guillotine, reverse arm triangle, arm triangle and the gator.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Short.for: No-gi players who want a quick look at the main head-and-arm chokes.
key: Arm triangle and reverse arm triangle

10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Warmu.overview: The 10th Planet warm-up series, eight drill sets labelled A to H: granby rolls, Hail Mary escapes, pressure passes, standing passes, quarter guard, butterflies, top half guard passes and open guards. Each is a solo or partner drill block used at the start of class.
10th Planet Collection/10th Planet Warmu.for: Anyone wanting structured movement drills to warm up or drill alone.

files.10th Planet Warm Ups_ B Series - Hail Ma: B series: Hail Mary escape drills.
files.10th Planet Warm Ups_ G Series - Top Hal: G series: top half guard passing drills.

10th Planet Collection/Bjorn Friedrich -.overview: A single 16-minute video from Bjorn Friedrich on his 'monster truck' approach: getting to the truck and choosing between calf cranks (calf slicers) and taking the back.
10th Planet Collection/Bjorn Friedrich -.for: No-gi players already familiar with the truck.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: A six-part course (about 4.5 hours) from Brandon 'B-Mac' McCaghren on no-gi mount: getting to mount, keeping it against bridges and elbow escapes, and attacking with arm triangles, armbars and back takes. The parts are numbered rather than titled.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: Top players who lose mount or can't finish from it.
key: Mount retention against bridges and frames
Arm triangle and armbar from mount
sources: Based on the course title and B-Mac's published material; parts are not labelled by topic.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: B-Mac's triangle course in seven chapters: the 'home base' position and the perfect finish, alternate finishes, the hip bump triangle, installing the flow (chaining entries), and triangles from mount, from side control and from the back (rear triangle).
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: Anyone who wants a complete triangle game from guard and top.
key: Mounted, side control and rear triangles

files.Alternate Finishes.mp4: Other ways to finish when the standard triangle won't close.
files.Hip Bump Triangle.mp4: Using the hip bump to set up the triangle.
files.Home Base and the Perfect Finish.mp4: The core triangle position and how to finish it.
files.Installing the flow.mp4: Chaining the entries and finishes together.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: B-Mac's escape collection: defending the darce with perfect posture, three parts on defending and escaping the back, the Lister escape (surviving and escaping the triangle), the Sanford slip, escaping the sky dive mount, a four-part back escape to deep half guard, and opening the closed guard.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: No-gi players who want practical escapes from the back, triangles and mount.
key: Back escapes, including to deep half

files.3 Lister Escape - Triangle Survival and: Surviving and escaping the triangle (Dean Lister's method).
files.6.1 Back Escape to Deep Half Guard.mp4: Back escape to deep half, part 1.
files.7 Opening the Closed Guard.mp4: Opening the closed guard from top.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: B-Mac's deep half guard course: getting under the opponent into deep half, the waiter and other sweeps, back takes and leg attacks, and staying safe underneath. The files come from his online academy and are only numbered.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: Half guard players who want to go underneath.
key: Back takes and leg attacks from deep half
sources: Based on the course title; lessons are only numbered.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: A four-volume course (about 2.75 hours) from B-Mac on the meathook, a rubber guard variation where your leg hooks over the opponent's back like an overhook. Covers posture control, the transitions and the submissions from it.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: Rubber guard players and flexible closed guard players.
sources: Based on the course title; volumes are not labelled by topic.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: Four short lessons on surviving heavy top pressure: the elbow frame, the kickstand (using a leg as a post to create space), bothering the opponent's head, and posture on the bottom.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: Newer grapplers who get flattened and stuck underneath.

files.Lesson 1 Elbow Frame .mp4: Using the elbow frame to stop the pressure.
files.Lesson 3 Bother the Head.mp4: Pushing and controlling the head to disrupt pressure.

10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.overview: B-Mac's course on the truck: entries from turtle, half guard and the back, and the finishes (twister, calf slicer, back takes). The files come from his online academy and are only numbered.
10th Planet Collection/Brandon McCraghre.for: No-gi players who want the truck as a back take and submission route.
sources: Based on the course title; lessons are only numbered.

10th Planet Collection/Brent Littell - T.overview: A single 69-minute video from Brent Littell on the lockdown, the 10th Planet half guard where you tie up the opponent's leg with both of yours. Covers locking it, the whip-up to break their posture, the electric chair and the old school sweep.
10th Planet Collection/Brent Littell - T.for: Half guard players who want to try the lockdown.
sources: Based on the title and the standard lockdown curriculum.

10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.overview: Eddie Bravo's three-part 'Mastering' series in two versions. The three 'Original' files are the older full-length versions (about 6 hours together); the other three are newer, shorter edits of the same topics. Part 1 is the half guard (lockdown, whip-up, electric chair), part 2 the rubber guard path, and part 3 the spider web armbar system.
10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.for: Anyone learning the 10th Planet system from its creator.

10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.overview: A single 2.5-hour video from Eddie Bravo on the twister, his signature spinal lock: getting to the truck and twister side control, setting up the twister and finishing it.
10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.for: No-gi players interested in the twister and truck.

10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.overview: A documentary (about 1h 45m) about Eddie Bravo, the twister and the story of 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu. Not an instructional.

Eddie Bravo's four-volume rubber guard course: getting from closed guard to mission control, then the progression through chill dog, New York and the zombie, with attacks like the omoplata, gogoplata and triangle along the way.
10th Planet Collection/Eddie Bravo/Eddie.for: Flexible closed guard players and 10th Planet students.
key: Chill dog, New York and zombie
sources: Based on the title and the standard rubber guard curriculum; volumes are not labelled by topic.

10th Planet Collection/Geo Martinez - Tr.overview: Geo Martinez's truck course in four parts, plus a separate video mixing the truck, rubber guard and guillotines. Covers truck entries from many positions and the follow-ups: twister, calf slicer, banana split and back takes.
10th Planet Collection/Geo Martinez - Tr.for: No-gi players building a truck game.

files.Geo Martinez - The Truck, Rubber Guard,: A mixed session on the truck, rubber guard and guillotines.

sources: Based on the title; the four main parts are only numbered.

10th Planet Collection/JM Holland - 10th.overview: JM Holland's four-volume introduction to the 10th Planet curriculum for beginners: core escapes, guard basics (including half guard and rubber guard foundations) and the main submissions, taught as a foundation for the rest of the system.
10th Planet Collection/JM Holland - 10th.for: Beginners, or anyone new to the 10th Planet approach.
sources: Based on the title; volumes are not labelled by topic.

10th Planet Collection/Magnus Hanson - L.overview: A 94-minute video from Magnus Hanson on the 'lotus lockdown', a lockdown half guard variation, with the sweeps and attacks that come from it.
10th Planet Collection/Magnus Hanson - L.for: Lockdown players who want a variation.

10th Planet Collection/Scott Epstein - 1.overview: Two discs of techniques from 10th Planet black belts, presented by Scott Epstein. Disc 1 has a main feature and a bonus; disc 2 has two titles. The discs aren't labelled by technique.
10th Planet Collection/Scott Epstein - 1.for: A sampler of different 10th Planet coaches' signature moves.
key: Signature techniques from 10th Planet black belts
sources: Based on the title; discs are not labelled by technique.

10th Planet Collection/Zach Maslany - Ge.overview: Zach Maslany's three-part introduction to the 10th Planet system for newer students, covering the key positions and how they connect.
sources: Based on the title; parts are only numbered.
